issue.title: Similar tasks band in Bob Mac Capture
issue.description: When a capture draft will create new tasks, Bob Mac Capture quietly shows the few existing tasks each one may duplicate. The rows appear after typing settles, at the foot of the new task's own preview card, and take zero pixels otherwise. One keyboard-driven draft edit can fold, relate, or link a match, and typing, the live preview, and Return stay exactly as fast as today.
